I don’t have real‑time data access, so I can’t tell you the exact temperature right now.  
You can quickly check the current weather in Riga by:

- Visiting a weather website such as [weather.com](https://weather.com) or [accuweather.com](https://www.accuweather.com) and searching for “Riga”.
- Using a weather app on your phone (e.g., Weather, AccuWeather, or the built‑in weather app).
- Asking a voice assistant (Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa) for “current temperature in Riga”.

If you’d like, I can give you a quick example of how to fetch this information programmatically using a weather API (e.g., OpenWeatherMap). Let me know!
